name: micro_crowd
description: 12 Binance-metrics majors, time-series contrarian to the retail long/short account ratio (and/or with top traders vs retail), 6h decisions, vol-targeted.
mechanism: Crowded retail positioning (high global L/S) is fuel for liquidations against it; top accounts leaning the other way are better informed. Retail L/S chases past returns, so the part not explained by momentum is the candidate signal.
frozen_rule: config with the best MEDIAN within-fold train rank across walk-forward folds (tie: mean train Sharpe)

implementability_200.note: round_to_qty=True with load_bybit_instruments() on the stitched OOS weights; dropped share is an estimate (orders whose |delta notional| < max(minNotionalValue, minOrderQty*price) at the unrounded equity).

expectancy_units: USD per closed round trip on the $200 OOS account

causality.plus_walk_forward_guard: passed (walk_forward causality_checks=2 per fold raised nothing)

caveats: Metrics history starts 2021-12 (11 of 12 coins): walk-forward uses 365d training windows, OOS starts 2022-12.
Top-trader ratio is NaN for most of 2022 in the Binance archive; 'D' variants hold nothing then.
Live: Bybit has the account ratio (/v5/market/account-ratio) but no top-trader ratio; Binance public fapi needed for zT.
The 12 majors are highly correlated: this is mostly a single market-timing bet, not 12 independent ones.
screen_evidence: Pooled Driscoll-Kraay partial t (controls r24, r7d) train/test: -zG 1.95/2.83 (6h), 2.49/2.00 (24h); D 2.19/3.28 (6h), 1.80/2.79 (24h). The phase-1 'extreme' rule failed (results/micro_crowd_extreme.json).
bug_hunt: -zG correlates +0.36 with r24 and +0.26 with r7d (Binance retail L/S FALLS into rallies on the majors: contrarian retail), so part of the signal is short-term momentum. Regressing the frozen dev returns on 24h/7d/30d TSMOM baskets built the same way leaves an intercept of ~40%/yr (in-sample alpha Sharpe ~2.1): it is not just momentum.
But the pre-registered PARTIAL form (zG residualised on r24, r7d per coin) is weak as a strategy (dev Sharpe 0.35); the tradable edge uses raw zG.

FROZEN holds 6h (H=1). With the decision delayed one more 6h bar the dev Sharpe drops 1.58 -> 0.62: most of the edge is in the first 6h after the reading. The metric is taken as knowable at stamp + 5 min (data.load_metrics), which is exact or 5 min conservative per the data agent's verification.
Decay: OOS 2023 +68% (Sharpe 2.35), 2024 +11% (0.58), 2025H1 -4.5% (-0.37); the last two walk-forward folds are negative.
Fee drag 15%/yr (turnover 188x/yr); 2x fees -> dev Sharpe 1.06, 3x slippage -> 1.09.
Long side carries it (dev long-leg Sharpe 1.68 vs short-leg 0.41); mean net exposure ~0.
verdict_rule:
Family-E verdict rule (applied identically to every module):
      p_used = the LARGER p-value of the two nulls, ignoring a random-timing 'runs' null whose
               mean turnover is > 1.5x the strategy's (the shuffled continuous weights then pay
               far more costs, which biases that null DOWN - see lab_bugs_found).
      promising: OOS Sharpe >= 0.8, p_used <= 0.05, deflated Sharpe (grid trials) >= 0.9 and
                 >= 60% of OOS calendar years positive.
      marginal : OOS Sharpe >= 0.5 and p_used <= 0.10.
      fails    : otherwise.
      Fragility downgrade (one level): any +/-1 grid-step neighbour of FROZEN with a negative
      dev Sharpe, or a dev Sharpe below 0.25 when fees are doubled (robustness_dev_frozen).
